proof_findings.reason: The ex-dividend drift is mu, total expected return mu+q. Stock and bank product terms reconcile to the dividend-funded gains identity. For generic C1,2 solutions, converse funding is proved via dv and predictable delta, without silently assuming v_s is itself C1,2; the stronger product identity is applied to smooth vanilla holdings before maturity.

Positive exponential-normal density has unit mean and conditional martingale property. Finite-partition square completion gives independent means -lambda*h and variances h; conditional calculation and equivalent completed filtrations supply the Brownian information requirement. Substitution in explicit GBM avoids unsupported stochastic-integral transformations. No general stochastic-lambda Girsanov theorem is claimed.

Each dividend is discounted at its receipt date; alternatively reinvested-dividend wealth is explicitly distinguished. Q-square-integrable discounted stock exposure makes discounted portfolio gains true martingales and proves the restricted no-arbitrage expectation argument. Bounded vanilla deltas plus GBM second moments establish that class for the constructed hedges.

Upper/lower truncated lognormal integrals lead to distinct d1/d2 terms. Density cancellation proves derivatives and analytical PDE residuals; calendar-time signs, dividend-adjusted delta, P versus Q probabilities and discounted bounds all agree.

Interior C1,2, terminal continuity and uniform linear growth are explicit. Stop on compact state/time sets; bounded integrand yields zero expected stopped integral. Strictly positive continuous GBM makes stops approach T. c07 Doob L2 plus exponential moments supplies integrable supremum domination for the limit. Terminal payoff kink is handled by continuity/Lipschitz mean-square convergence, not fictitious derivatives.

Zero volatility with live stock requires mu+q=r; changing probability cannot remove a sure return gap. Expiry, absorbing spot and deterministic threshold are distinct branches, with unavailable Greeks flagged. Negative rates preserve positive discount factors and can put PV above strike. Fixed cash dividends need jump matching and a boundary/payment model; matching one prepaid price is not exact option equivalence.

Between resets dividends buy shares; signed bank accrues independently. All trades preserve marked wealth with no external cash. Both payoff surplus and debt shortfall are reproduced. Density underflow retains finite log and null/flag, preserving the distinction from mathematical equivalence; extreme option tail underflow has an absolute-error scope.
